what_happened: Scene: layout 8, black/silver single-pair toaster with its lever and knob on the side facing the robot's right (same kitchen as s9/s12), bread in the left slot. Stage 0: the lever was pushed 144-192 (0.19, 0.28, then 1.0, the bread dropped 6.7 cm), toaster on 191-690. The fingers were closed 200-1064. The lever rose 704-928 and stage 0 completed at 899 (online 912). Stage 1: 912-1640 the gripper hovered at the toaster's lever end, looking at the lever face and knob, with the popped bread visible at the slot end beyond. The fingers opened 1072-1552 and 1568-1800, but the gripper never moved over the slot or touched the bread. It touched the toaster housing at 912-937, 1059-1088 and 1517-1600. From 1662 it worked the lever again: the lever went 0.04 -> 0.32 (1664-1744), then 1.0 at ~1789. The toaster switched on again (on 1789-2000) and the bread went back down 6.6 cm, so the stage-0 condition dropped at 1674. The arm then lifted away (1868-1990). At the end the bread was inside the toaster, toasting a second time.
causal_chain: correct press (192) -> pop-up done 899 -> ~750 steps hovering at the lever end with the fingers open, no approach to the bread -> pushed the lever down again at 1664-1792, re-toasting the bread -> bread inside the toaster at 2000
self_recovery: none for the bread; the re-press made things worse (stage 0 undone).
official_criterion_notes: Stage 0 'undone' at 1674/1684 is real: the robot pushed the lever back down and the toaster switched on again at 1789.
